descriptionChirho: Qal stative verb meaning to be agreeable, lovely, or delightful. Used of wisdom's words being pleasant when kept within (Prov 2:10; 24:25), of a land being pleasant (Gen 49:15), of a beloved being pleasant (Song 7:6), of words of the righteous being pleasant (Ps 141:6), and of Pharaoh's description of Egypt (Ezek 32:19). All occurrences share the same basic stative meaning across perfect and imperfect forms. Multilingual glosses consistently render: Ar. ladhidh/yatibu, Ger. lieblich, Sp. agradable/deliciosa, Hin. ananddayak/manohar, Kor. jeulgeopta/gippeuda.
